stage_timings.basis: Fresh beacon and compact-frontier refs exist, but exact stage transition timing was not durably measured.
Five atomic authority CREATE attempts were observable; per-attempt server timing was not durably recorded.
Terminal no-allocation and exam timestamps are durable; audit-write interval itself was not separately measured.

friction_events.description: First beacon CREATE hit a 409 branch-head movement; the same atomic CREATE then succeeded without pre-reading the candidate path.
All five retained compatible authority paths returned the canonical GitHub Contents CREATE_EXISTS 422 signature before ownership.
Direct public exit-page fetch returned a cache miss; exact gh-pages file fetch through GitHub supplied the audit contract.

decision_trace.decision: Launch as a new PROD-01 canary worker.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Human invocation carried NUEVO_WORKER=1, POOL PROD-01 and resident-continuation markers.
decision_trace.action: Created a de-novo v3.30 beacon before allocation.

decision_trace.decision: Use only the loaded compact claim frontier for pre-ownership allocation.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Frontier exposed READY, ROLE_READY and RECOVERY candidates and defined atomic CREATE as authority.
decision_trace.action: Attempted five retained compatible claim paths with lane switching after bounded READY contention.
decision_trace.outcome: Each attempt returned CREATE_EXISTS; no ownership was acquired.

decision_trace.decision: Stop without broad discovery after bounded compatible-candidate exhaustion.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Every candidate retained from the compact frontier had collided and the worker held no PIN/claim authority.
decision_trace.action: Persisted STOP_NO_RECOVERY and this terminal exam/audit.
decision_trace.outcome: Worker closed truthfully with zero productive units and no recovery debt.

top_time_sinks.note: Five atomic claims all collided before ownership.
One branch-head race required repeating the beacon CREATE.

unfinished_debt.item: No owned project work was executed because authority was never acquired.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Reduce stale claim hints or increase simultaneously useful candidate diversity when a freshly generated compact frontier is already fully contended.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Fewer fresh workers terminate with zero ownership after bounded atomic races.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Treat branch-head movement during unique-path CREATE as a bounded transparent retry when path existence is still unproven.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Lower identity-launch friction without weakening create-if-absent semantics.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh PROD-01 worker created its own v3.30 beacon, loaded one compact frontier, lost five atomic claim races across READY/ROLE_READY/RECOVERY, acquired no authority, and durably closed STOP_NO_RECOVERY with zero productive units.
